paragraphs.text:
You hear the clattering and banging in the next room and 
pointedly ignore it. Whatever may be going on there, it doesn’t 
involve you. You finish setting things straight and take a deep 
breath, pondering your options.

You have precious few. You could see if the hotel owner saw 
anyone coming and going. The establishment is small, and they 
would likely notice anything going on. Maybe that way you 
could set about recovering your lost belongings.

Another option is to continue your investigation surrounding 
the late Prof. Harris and his artifacts. You could go into town to 
gather more information.

Alternatively, you could always just cut your losses and leave. 
The ferry won’t be running with the fog as dense as it is, but 
you could set out into the woods and try circling the lake. This 
would take several hours of walking through the wilderness in 
the mist, but with a little luck, you might be able to make it 
back to the road by nightfall.
• To search for your belongings, go to 134.
• To continue your investigation, go to 148.
